comparison.objective: Remove a funnel and recap a waste jug, unlike adjusting a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Extract/stow a funnel and screw on a cap.
comparison.success_condition: Funnel is on its drip tray and the jug is capped; the indexed body omits numeric rubric details.
comparison.reason: Ordinary cap fastening does not include setting a coupled stop or verifying retained articulated motion.
